prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Mina Castellan for the job below.

About the freelancer: 5 years experience; skills: SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard, data cleaning, data visualization

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Google Analytics - Set up, analysis & insights
Brief: Six by Nico (Six Company) is a restaurant group with 13 locations in the UK & Ireland. Our Goal is to view valuable and actionable data that can be measured and compared against success, allowing us to continue to grow and measure brand growth versus performance activity. Giving us the opportunity to pull certain levers when we require to optimise performance based on menu targets and what campaigns, channels, and audience targeting to tap into and invest in for short term activations. Firstly making sure, all our tracking is set up correctly before creating dashboards for the following objectives. We also want to compare YOY from 2022 data and also exclude/include new locations affecting numbers where possible.
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open by restating the client's specific problem in one sentence.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Write 300 to 380 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
You need accurate tracking, analysis, and dashboards that turn your Google Analytics data into clear, actionable insights for measuring brand growth, campaign performance, and location-by-location results across your 13 UK and Ireland sites.

Hi, I’m Mina Castellan, and I can help you build a reporting setup that makes performance easier to understand and act on. With 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization, I focus on turning messy or incomplete data into something structured, reliable, and useful for decision-making.

For this project, I would start by reviewing your current tracking setup to make sure the data is being captured correctly before any dashboards are built. That foundation is important if you want to compare performance across locations, campaigns, channels, audience targeting, and menu-related activity. I can then help create a reporting view that highlights the metrics that matter most to your goals, so you can see what is working, what is not, and where to focus next.

I’m also comfortable working with SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets, which means I can clean and organize data, support analysis, and build dashboards that are easy to use and update. If you need year-over-year comparisons against 2022 data, I can help structure the reporting so that trends are easier to compare. I can also account for new locations where possible so the numbers stay meaningful and are not distorted by openings that affect the overall picture.

My approach is practical and business-focused: set up the tracking properly, confirm the data is trustworthy, and then build dashboards and insights that help you make decisions faster. Whether you want to monitor short-term activations, evaluate campaign impact, or compare performance across locations, I can help you create a reporting system that supports those goals.

If you’d like, I can help you map out the key metrics and dashboard structure first, then move into analysis and setup from there.
